items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: We first met in the eighth grade... We came apart after college... she bewitched me. But she’s the best thing that ever happened to me. She’s been a wonderful — she’s gotten into jazz right up to here. She has befriended and been befriended by all my jazz friends

ctx.x: There’s an interesting story about the longevity of how long you two actually knew each other.

It was quite a while but we don’t like to add up the years really. We first met in the eighth grade at John Marshall High School in Rochester, New York. And we have known of each other since. We came apart after college, when I went to college and she went to college. We met again in Buffalo when I went up to sign up in the Navy, enlist in the Navy, that’s another story. And I ran into her and we knew each other, and we’d have gotten married then but she didn’t return my phone call. Anyway, so it went on and then…
You got that right. And I enjoyed playing at your wedding.
